title: C# basics
key_points: C# is a high-level programming language developed by Microsoft.
In Godot, C# is implemented with the modern .NET runtime.
This page provides an introduction to C#, both what it is and how to use it in Godot.
The page also discusses prerequisites for using C# in Godot, configuring an external editor, creating a C# script, and project setup and workflow.
limitations: Projects written in C# using Godot 4 cannot be exported to the web platform. Android and iOS platform support is available but experimental.
This page provides only a brief introduction to C#, and users may need to look at other resources for specific features or details on the differences between the C# and GDScript API.
asserts: C# can be used for scripting in Godot, with the modern .NET runtime implemented in the process.
scope: The scope of this page is to provide a brief introduction to using C# for scripting in the Godot game engine.
